paper_convention_note: The paper counts thread lengths in MARKABLE edges; a tree-level leaf thread of L markable edges has L+1 total edges (pendant edge at the end). Piece leaf threads = tree leaf threads - 1. So Q11.4 trees (internal<=2, leaf<=3 markable) correspond to pieces with internal<=2, leaf<=3 (all piece edges markable). pc3's 'tree 3 4' args are (internal total, leaf total).

reductionsEstablished: Counterexample to Q11.4 == piece X (tree, leaves status f, all other vertices status n, internal threads <= 2 edges, leaf threads <= 3 edges) with g(X) != |E(X)| mod 2.

Realization: T = X plus one pendant leaf attached to each leaf of X gives an initially empty tree whose only nontrivial piece is X (m(T)=|E(X)|, g(T)=g(X)); all piece leaves are special vertices of T.
Hence a counterexample piece has >= 23 vertices given the source's <= 22-vertex search (19,570 twin-free, non-path).
